# Gentleskin

> A gentle iPhone app for tracking skin picking (dermatillomania, excoriation disorder) and other body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRBs). Log a pick in two taps, see patterns, ride out urges, and make a PDF report for a therapist. No streaks.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789245158
- Price: 7-day free trial, then $29.99/year or $5.99/month (US; varies by region)

## Guides

- [What is dermatillomania (skin picking disorder)? | Gentleskin](https://gentleskin.app/guides/what-is-dermatillomania/): Dermatillomania, or excoriation disorder, is repeated skin picking that's hard to stop. What it looks like, why it happens, and where to get help.
- [How to stop picking your skin: what actually helps | Gentleskin](https://gentleskin.app/guides/how-to-stop-picking-skin/): A practical, shame-free guide to stopping skin picking: noticing your triggers, giving your hands something else to do, changing your surroundings, and riding out urges.
- [Urge surfing for skin picking: how to ride out the urge | Gentleskin](https://gentleskin.app/guides/urge-surfing/): Urge surfing is a mindfulness skill for riding out the urge to pick your skin instead of fighting it. How it works and how to practice it in under a minute.
- [Scalp picking: why it happens and how to stop | Gentleskin](https://gentleskin.app/guides/scalp-picking/): Scalp picking is a common form of skin picking. Why your fingers end up in your hair, what keeps it going, and practical ways to cut down.
- [Why track your skin picking (and what to bring to therapy) | Gentleskin](https://gentleskin.app/guides/tracking-skin-picking/): Tracking skin picking shows you when, where and why it happens, which is the first step of habit reversal. What to log, how to keep it shame-free, and what to share with a therapist.
